items.html: However, although his principal suckling is from that path that is in the middle, as mentioned, nevertheless the thirteen whitenesses also shine upon Zeir Anpin, for the nine whitenesses that are drawn along the face of Arich Anpin extend to the beard of Zeir Anpin, and by their power nine corrections of the beard are made for Zeir Anpin, as is said in its place. And from the four whitenesses of the back, they extend until the head of Zeir Anpin and shine upon his head itself, above, and not upon the beard.
